scope: Independent mathematical/type/boundary source review; compilation/trust supplied by U00.
findings: The fine-fiber mask F=1_H f prevents fine fibers outside the coarse event from contributing.
On positive fine fibers inside H, the representative exists and hpoint applies; H has conditional probability one.
Null fine fibers use totalized zero and need no hpoint assumption.
The total-expectation and total-probability identities are combined with the same fine atom weights and divided only by strictly positive coarse probability.
The arbitrary-codomain wrapper uses the finite sampled image of Z, preserving equality fibers; only the original sample space needs Fintype.
No sign assumption on f or c and no positivity of every fine atom is smuggled in; no source endpoint follows without the concrete hpoint proofs.
